verdict.rationale: The API is path-versioned (`POST /v1/systemone`, `GET /v1/models`). Models carry versioned IDs (`jev-1.13.0`) with documented `jev-latest`/`jev-preview` aliases, guidance to pin a version and migrate on your own schedule, and the answering version reported in each response. An SDK changelog also exists. However, nothing documents a deprecation or sunset policy for API versions or pinned models. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation/sunset policy with notice periods for API and model versions, an API versioning policy beyond the /v1 path, and independent corroboration.
